documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30,2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Standalone And Consolidated Un-Audited Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30 2026.

analysis.summary: Chembond Chemicals Limited reported a strong performance in the second half of FY26, with consolidated revenue reaching Rs. 188 crores, up 35% over H1. The water technologies segment remains the largest business unit, contributing 87% of the total revenue. While the company is starting the new financial year with a strong order book, it is facing margin pressures due to rising metal and chemical input costs post-war declaration. Management is actively managing these cost headwinds by seeking price increases in the private sector and implementing contingent actions.

guidance.claim: The company expects around 15% to 20% volume growth in construction chemicals in the first quarter of the year.
guidance.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.

guidance.claim: The company expects around 10% volume growth in water chemicals.
guidance.quote: Water chemicals, it would be roughly around 10%.

guidance.claim: The company aspires to reach 1000 crore and is working on plans to achieve it.
guidance.quote: So 1000 crore is, yes, it is an aspiratory number. We are trying to ensure that we have plans in place to get to that number.

guidance.claim: The company's revenue outlook remains positive.
guidance.quote: Revenue outlook continues to remain positive.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is seeing a pickup in the drinking water disinfection and AHU fin cleaning segment, driven by data centers and commercial buildings.
demand_outlook.quote: We are seeing some pickup in this segment, especially driven by a lot of data centers and commercial buildings having significantly large AHUs. in place.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is experiencing significant growth in sealants and plans to consolidate its presence in that segment.
demand_outlook.quote: Sealants, we are seeing a significant growth and we intend to consolidate our presence in that segment through our polysulfide and PU sealants.

demand_outlook.claim: The sales growth outlook is positive across all business units with strong sales pipelines.
demand_outlook.quote: All of these businesses are having strong sales pipelines and we see that the sales growth outlook looks positive across all these business units.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to deploy some of its funds into network growth and geographical expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: We intend to deploy some of it in network growth and geographical expansion.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested ₹90.76 lakhs towards the installation of the 350 kVA solar plant at Dudhwada during FY 2025-26.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹90.76 lakhs were invested towards installation of the 350 kVA solar renewable energy plant at the Dudhwada, Gujarat manufacturing site during FY 2025-26.

margins_costs.claim: Most of the margin improvements were driven by lower costs.
margins_costs.quote: Most of the margin improvements are, of course, on lower costs.

margins_costs.claim: Material costs began to rise starting from late February and March.
margins_costs.quote: Material costs started increasing from March, end of Feb, March.

margins_costs.claim: The company experienced a 3% impact on margins in the immediate month due to volatile costs.
margins_costs.quote: But in the immediate month, we saw about a 3% impact on our margins due to these haywire costs.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability is currently facing some challenges despite a positive revenue outlook.
margins_costs.quote: However, on the earnings, profitability is a little bit of a challenge right now.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is starting the financial year with a strong order book for its chemicals business.
orders_capacity.quote: So we are starting this financial year with a strong order book for our chemicals business also.

orders_capacity.claim: The water business unit is entering the year with a strong order book for both chemicals and equipment.
orders_capacity.quote: Water BU, we are entering this, as I mentioned earlier, with a strong order book for chemicals as well as for the equipment.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains a tight credit policy with day sales outstanding for construction chemicals at around 88 days as of March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We are maintaining a tight credit policy and our day sales outstanding for construction chemicals is around 88 days as on 31st of March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of ₹1.25 per equity share of ₹5 each, aggregating to ₹336.20 lakhs for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has recommended a final dividend of ₹1.25 (Rupee One and Paise Twenty-Five only) per equity share of ₹5 (Rupees Five only) each, aggregating to ₹336.20 lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: The period following the declaration of war was highly challenging.
risks_headwinds.quote: And post-war declaration, it was a very challenging period.

risks_headwinds.claim: Public sector units, which make up about 30% of the water business, did not accept force majeure until the government declared it.
risks_headwinds.quote: About 30 percent of our total business in the water business comes from public sector units, and none of them had accepted a force majeure until the government just declared it two weeks ago.

risks_headwinds.claim: The second quarter of the first half was slow due to the monsoon.
risks_headwinds.quote: In first half year, our quarter two was slow on account of monsoon, but yes, quarter three and quarter four picked up.

risks_headwinds.claim: A prolonged monsoon from May to October impacted construction activity and sales.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you'll see, the first half of both the construction and the distribution businesses were low and we mentioned last time that the 15% decrease that you see here is primarily the first half, the pro longed monsoon.

management_commitments.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.
